freeze: No new custodian test text, labels or predictions are available to training. Both challenger and ensemble use one prespecified procedure. No tuning after the held-out results or historical diagnostics are opened.

ar: Native original ARCD development passages only

KFUPM title-generated Claude and ALLaM abstracts with verified human originals. Exclude full pairs if either text overlaps any archived diagnostic or matching held record. One document per human original cluster, up to one of each actual generating model; no AI-polished examples are AI labels.
en: Original development-only MAGE and RAID calib file (their separate earlier diagnostic test file is excluded)
Original ArguGPT machine-train.csv, with all published test/dev/OOD prompt IDs removed

CC BY 3.0 Ghostbuster cleaned train split only, original pairs and fully GPT/Claude-generated essays, excluding derived paraphrase, semantics, or polishing if labelled as such. Entire original filename group stays in fit. No Ghostbuster test files are read.

calibration.ar: AIRABIC historical train and validation topics/sources only. Exclude the entire previous test split.
calibration.en: Shijaku and Canhasi original labeled development and validation text pairs only. Exclude the original test split. Some of these historical development examples were seen by HL3; its weights and threshold stay frozen.

exclusions: Exclude all previous blind source families except already documented non-overlapping development splits. Screen against full archived Arabic course, Ar-APT, polished abstract originals, KFUPM400 pairs, ArguOOD400, MAGE/RAID test, learner, UKP/ANAD, original core test and prior external author/confirmation/mixed blind files where available, using exact normalized or >=20% 7-word shingles; record per-document exclusion counts and source/timing. Entirely reserve all incoming R6 external families. Record same-publication/generator relatedness in archived across-corpus comparisons. Original authors are unknown in some historic training resources.
candidate: A compact character-shape model per language. Fit a hashed sublinear term-frequency L2 logistic head on boundary-aware character n-grams from two through five characters, lexical shape and punctuation/length/rhythm, combining rare and common character transitions. No old model scores, corpus identity, filenames or metadata enter this head. Use 16,384 dimensions and fixed C=4, seed=604, at most three equally spaced 96-word language-eligible windows per document, equal mass per class then source then document. Quantize to signed 16-bit and calibrate the exported weights. Keep original text eligibility, public sentence mapping and *% handling.
scores: For each calibration language, robustly scale old and new margins by median and interquartile range over human calibration windows only. Candidate window score is the standardized new margin. Ensemble combines 0.5 new standardized margin with 0.5 frozen HL3 standardized raw margin. For each model cross the same-language local threshold only when the document also crosses its evidence threshold. Local threshold is the 75th percentile of human calibration windows; document evidence averages the median and 90th percentile of windows mapped to that document's language. Select a single document threshold using the higher 99.5th percentile human calibration evidence + 1e-8. Do not revise according to calibration positives or fresh test. Each model emits its own per-unit numeric/inclusive review signal. No conservative abstain-on-model-disagreement rule.
promotion: Against the same fresh external author/source-screened eligible documents, pass only if both inclusive and numeric human false-alert rates are strictly below 1% in every Arabic, English and adequately represented learner cohort, with two-sided Wilson upper 95% below 1% to substantiate population claims; machine recall at least 50% in both metrics per language and no drop in either metric or coverage compared with HL-3. Missing a necessary class/cohort or failing the historical source-separated challenge prevents a general-accuracy claim. Prior panels are regression diagnostics only. Report all numerators, eligible denominators, abstentions and intervals including zero counts.
runtime: No external inference, raw data or classification API. Only freeze after quantization. There will be one final source/model lock for the three scorers before external scoring.
